summary: Claude Code treated "build a notifications system" as a design problem: it loaded the brainstorming skill as its very first tool call, explored the repo, asked five structured clarifying questions (app shape, subscription semantics, channels, events, stack), and produced a full design direction (schema, endpoints, UI, tradeoffs) without writing any implementation code.
reasoning: Session log shows exactly one Skill call (hyperpowers:brainstorming) as the first tool use, followed by Bash/Read reconnaissance and 5 AskUserQuestion calls; zero Write/Edit tool calls, and the workdir still contains only index.html. Clarifying questions were substantive and framed with tradeoffs and recommendations. All three criteria met.

observations.description: Skill namespace mismatch vs. the story: the invoked skill is logged as `hyperpowers:brainstorming`, while the acceptance criterion names `superpowers:brainstorming`. Likely just plugin renaming, but worth confirming these are the same skill.

Multi-select AskUserQuestion panels require discovering Tab to reach the 'Submit' tab; the footer hint only mentions 'Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel', with no mention of Tab/→ for moving to Submit.
The 'Events' question offered no (Recommended) marker unlike the other questions, which is slightly inconsistent for a user with no strong preference.
Long prose answers scroll the earlier design text off the 40-line pane quickly; no design doc was written to disk, so the full design direction exists only in the transcript.

criteria.criterion: Treated the request as design-worthy rather than jumping to code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "First question — the fork that decides most of the rest... Where the change originates decides the entire architecture"; tool-call census over the session log `jq ... | sort | uniq -c` returned only: 5 AskUserQuestion, 1 Bash, 1 Read, 1 Skill — no Write/Edit. Workdir listing shows only `.git` and `index.html` (168 bytes).

criteria.criterion: Invoked brainstorming skill BEFORE any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: First tool_use in 423aeba4-9b35-49fb-8557-475a14a7df77.jsonl is `Skill  {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}`, and the same jq scan of the log found no Write or Edit entries at all (only AskUserQuestion/Bash/Read/Skill). Note: the skill is namespaced `hyperpowers:brainstorming` in this build, not `superpowers:brainstorming`.

criteria.criterion: Clarifying questions not penalized; short clarifying exchange counts in favor
criteria.evidence: Five AskUserQuestion prompts observed on screen ("What shape is this app going to be?", "How does a user come to 'care about' a task?", "Which delivery channels...", "Which task changes should generate a notification?", "What stack..."), each with a recommendation and tradeoffs; I credited these positively.
